description: Compile reported CNNM4 Jalili-syndrome variant catalog and map to protein domains (UniProt Q6P4Q7, 775 aa)
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg"); import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

# CNNM4 (UniProt Q6P4Q7), 775 aa. Approx domain boundaries from UniProt/literature:
domains = [
    ("N-term/extracellular", 1, 129, "#cce5ff"),
    ("DUF21 / transmembrane", 130, 351, "#ffd9b3"),
    ("CBS-pair (Bateman)", 352, 519, "#d5f5d5"),
    ("CNBH (cyclic-nt binding homology)", 520, 695, "#f5d5e5"),
    ("C-terminal cytoplasmic", 696, 775, "#eeeeee"),
]
def dom(aa):
    if aa is None or (isinstance(aa,float) and np.isnan(aa)): return "undetermined"
    for n,s,e,_ in domains:
        if s<=aa<=e: return n
    return "undetermined"

# Reported pathogenic variants in Jalili syndrome
rows = [
 ("c.279delC","p.Phe93Leufs*31",93,"frameshift","North America (UPD chr2)","32022389"),
 ("c.598T>C","p.Ser200Pro",200,"missense","China","35150469"),
 ("c.706C>T","p.Arg236Trp",236,"missense","Guatemalan ancestry","32022389"),
 ("c.949A>C","p.Ser317Arg",317,"missense","China","41280631"),
 ("c.971T>C","p.Leu324Pro",324,"missense","Brazil/Portugal (recurrent)","29421602"),
 ("c.1076T>C","p.Leu359Pro",359,"missense","Poland","28586144"),
 ("c.1312dupC","p.(fs)",438,"frameshift","Kosovo (founder)","24194943"),
 ("c.1423G>A","p.?(~475)",475,"missense","Egypt","40232358"),
 ("c.1474G>T","p.Gly492Cys",492,"missense","(functional study)","39580587"),
 ("c.1475G>A","p.Gly492Asp",492,"missense","Thailand","36354001"),
 ("c.1682-1G>C","splice (intron3 acc)",561,"splice","Morocco","28246031"),
 ("c.1743C>G","p.Tyr581*",581,"nonsense","Brazil","29421602"),
 ("c.1813C>T","p.Arg605X",605,"nonsense","Amish (founder)","29322253"),
]
df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["cDNA","protein","aa_pos","class","population","PMID"])
df["domain"] = df["aa_pos"].apply(dom)
print("Reported CNNM4 Jalili-syndrome variants (n=%d)\n" % len(df))
print(df.to_string(index=False))

print("\n--- Distribution by variant class ---")
print(df["class"].value_counts().to_string())
print("\n--- Distribution by protein domain ---")
print(df["domain"].value_counts().to_string())

# Plot: lollipop of variants along protein with domain backbone
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12,3.2))
for n,s,e,c in domains:
    ax.add_patch(mpatches.Rectangle((s,0.0),e-s,0.25,color=c,ec="grey"))
    ax.text((s+e)/2,0.125,n.split(" /")[0].split(" (")[0],ha="center",va="center",fontsize=7)
cmap={"missense":"#1f77b4","nonsense":"#d62728","frameshift":"#2ca02c","splice":"#9467bd"}
for _,r in df.iterrows():
    ax.plot([r.aa_pos,r.aa_pos],[0.25,0.55],color=cmap[r["class"]],lw=1)
    ax.plot(r.aa_pos,0.58,"o",color=cmap[r["class"]],ms=6)
    ax.text(r.aa_pos,0.63,r.protein.replace("p.",""),rotation=55,fontsize=6,ha="left",va="bottom")
ax.set_xlim(0,800); ax.set_ylim(0,1.05); ax.set_yticks([])
ax.set_xlabel("CNNM4 amino acid position (775 aa, UniProt Q6P4Q7)")
ax.set_title("Reported pathogenic CNNM4 variants in Jalili syndrome, mapped to protein domains")
ax.legend(handles=[mpatches.Patch(color=v,label=k) for k,v in cmap.items()],
          loc="upper right",fontsize=7,ncol=4)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("cnnm4_variant_map.png",dpi=130)
print("\nSaved plot: cnnm4_variant_map.png")

# How many cluster in functional core (DUF21+CBS+CNBH)
core = df[df.domain.isin(["DUF21 / transmembrane","CBS-pair (Bateman)","CNBH (cyclic-nt binding homology)"])]
print(f"\nVariants in functional core (TM+CBS+CNBH): {len(core)}/{len(df)} = {100*len(core)/len(df):.0f}%")
